mapper.insert: insert into goodfish_account (goodfish_id, goodfish_nickname, remark, status, last_active_at) values (#{goodfishId}, #{goodfishNickname}, #{remark}, #{status}, #{lastActiveAt}) on conflict (goodfish_id) do update set goodfish_nickname = excluded.goodfish_nickname, remark = excluded.remark, last_active_at = excluded.last_active_at, update_time = now()
